consequence.statement: Existing ImagePolicy objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions on imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImagePolicy objects so they are stored as v1 and update status.storedVersions of imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta2.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagepolicies.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changed from v1beta2 to v1, so existing ImagePolicy objects stay stored as v1beta2 until an operator rewrites them and updates status.storedVersions, which must be done before a later release removes v1beta2.
